value.rationale: This is a complete sign-geometry theorem for a natural joint occupancy-spectrum diagnostic: the covariance can reverse twice, but never more; the many-ball fixed-capacity regime admits a sharp universal standardized deviation threshold for whether any positive pair-frequency dependence exists. The result distinguishes exact-frequency association from aggregate richness and supplies a nontrivial boundary in a parameterized family, not just a tabulated number or recomputation of the well-known covariance formula.
